## I study the **complexity of religious and spiritual life** and its place in human flourishing.

I am a fourth-year Ph.D. student in Social Psychology at the University of Wisconsin–Madison. My developing research program examines diverse forms of religious and spiritual experience, their existential significance, and their connections with eudaimonic well-being. I use person-centered and longitudinal methods to reveal patterns of experience and change that simpler measures can miss.
